title: The Old Light F1 - The Lobby of Groaners
_note: Pearlmoor Old Light, floor 1 (pearlmoor_oldlight_1). MR. PUNCHWHEEL's theme ("Punchwheel's Patter") played straight: a bouncy music-hall march, oom-pah bass + brass pah-stabs, a cheeky pulse25 lead, and at every 4th bar the lead stops so a pulse12 "ha-ha-ha" (three staccato falling glides) and a noise "pfft" fill the gap; a ba-dum-tss + bell ding closes each 8-bar section. Vesper motif bounced: C-F-G lift, A-G-F settle, stated whole in bar 1. snes register on the chip engine. 126 BPM, 4/4, F major, A(8) B(8) A'(8) = 24 bars. Bar 24 walks the bass C-D-E into bar 1's F.
